races.race_name: Durkin Bros. Electrical Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Manoir De Mirande
runners.spotlight: French bumper winner has run some fine races in defeat over hurdles; has been below form on his last two outings but was badly hampered at Roscommon six days ago; a major player if bouncing back, even penalised 8lb.
runners.comment: Badly hampered at Roscommon 6 days ago; major player if bouncing back even penalised 8lb

runners.name: Pebble Island
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat maiden ran his best race over hurdles when fourth in a Bellewstown novice last time; has a chance if backing up that run.
runners.comment: Fourth in a Bellewstown novice last time; has a chance if backing that run up

runners.name: Noble Rocco
runners.spotlight: Third runner for yard; was well beaten in a Ballinrobe bumper on debut and will have to make enormous improvement.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a Ballinrobe bumper on debut and will have to make enormous improvement

runners.name: I'm All In
runners.spotlight: Three starts in academy hurdles on softer ground than this; best run when in second place and unseating at the last at Cork on debut; on first run of the year, was tailed off at same venue on Friday; looks stable second-string
runners.comment: Some ability in academy hurdles but jumping problems too; tailed off at Cork on Friday

runners.name: Whats New
runners.spotlight: Flat winner has run well in defeat several times over hurdles, though has run out a couple of times too, including at Clonmel two starts ago; decent run at Bellewstown since and is a player even penalised 8lb.,
runners.comment: Ran out at Clonmel but a decent run at Bellewstown since; is a player even penalised 8lb

runners.name: Emmamia
runners.spotlight: Eleventh foal; half-sister to 2m/2m6f hurdle winner Roman Gold; dam 2m hurdle winner, sister to 2m hurdle winners Burdens Boy and Burdens Girl; by a useful young sire and from a decent damline ,but best watched on debut.
runners.comment: By a useful young sire and from a decent damline but best watched on debut

runners.name: Bobby Kirova
runners.spotlight: Some promise in Flat maidens last year but has been disappointing in handicaps this term; tongue-tie goes on for hurdles debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Has been disappointing in Flat handicaps this term; tongue-tie goes on for hurdles debut

runners.name: Megaball
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam 1m5f Flat (RPR 58) and 2m hurdle/chase winner, sister to 2m4f hurdle winner Give Us A Swig, half-sister to 2m chase winner Trooblue; unsold for E6,200 as a yearling; has a decent pedigree, but best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Has a decent pedigree but best watched on debut
runners.owner: A G Beatty & P McBride & Mrs Peter Casey & Mrs Paula Casey

runners.name: Sylvie Power
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam unraced sister to 2m4f hurdle/chase winner Yabo, out of 2m chase-winning half-sister to useful bumper and 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Valley Ride; by a young sire and from a decent damline; best watched on debut.
runners.comment: By a young sire and from a decent damline; best watched on debut

runners.name: Casheldale Lass
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner over approximately 1m2f but has been hit and miss this season; penalised 8lb on hurdles debut, so will have to put up a big effort to defy that.
runners.comment: Flat winner; penalised 8lb on hurdles debut; will have to put up a big effort to defy that

runners.name: The Chancie Grey
runners.spotlight: Beaten 18l in a Clonmel maiden hurdle that fell apart early on; can do better, but others preferred today.
runners.comment: Beaten 18l in a Clonmel maiden hurdle that fell apart early on; others preferred today

runners.name: Beat The Devil
runners.spotlight: Flat winner was pulled-up on hurdles debut in testing ground last November, but a much better effort in a Downpatrick novice last time; penalised 8lb and still needs a fair bit more.
runners.comment: Solid run in a Downpatrick novice last time; penalised 8lb and still needs a fair bit more

races.race_name: CT Electrical Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Returning Officer
runners.spotlight: The best of his three bumper starts was on debut last year behind a useful rival; not as good in two starts after an absence, but Punchestown last time was a slowly-run race; looks a player in this weak maiden hurdle.
runners.comment: Some fine bumper runs and looks a player in this weak maiden hurdle

runners.name: Brother Hollie
runners.spotlight: Some promise in maidens; best handicap run came at Kilbeggan last time; needs to find more, but could be involved.
runners.comment: Best handicap run came at Kilbeggan last time; needs to find more but could be involved

runners.name: Nile Star
runners.spotlight: The best of four maiden hurdle runs came at Wexford last time over 2m4f but was still beaten 23l; however, there should be improvement to come and shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: Beaten 23l last time but there should be improvement to come and shouldn't be far away

runners.name: Unknown Fortune
runners.spotlight: Late starter showed some improvement on second hurdle run at Kilbeggan, but plenty more is needed.
runners.comment: Some improvement on second hurdle run at Kilbeggan but plenty more is needed

runners.name: Rosenborg
runners.spotlight: Not a bad run in sole completed point start and in two maiden hurdles since, at Punchestown and over C&D; this is a weaker race, so could be more involved.
runners.comment: Some promise incl' C&D last time; this is a weaker race so could be more involved

runners.name: Hey Sir
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; maiden in points and chases doesn't make much appeal, even in this weak contest; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Maiden in points and chases doesn't make much appeal even in this weak contest

runners.name: Tribal
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in three maiden hurdles and will have to find plenty more, even in a weaker race.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in three maidens and will have to find plenty more even in a weaker race

runners.name: Boo Radley
runners.spotlight: Started 13-8 favourite for a Roscommon bumper last August, but was found to be blowing hard after being well beaten; raced keenly when again a beaten favourite at Tramore in October, but a better effort; hood added for jumps debut and half-brother to pair of useful hurdlers has to considered.
runners.comment: Beaten fav' in two bumpers but better last time; hood added for hurdles debut; big player
runners.owner: Brian M Keenan & P W Mullins

runners.name: Tommy Go Maith
runners.spotlight: Little sign of promise in three starts and can't be fancied.
runners.comment: Little sign of promise in three starts and can't be fancied

runners.name: Middlethird Marvel
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; tailed-off on hurdles debut at Roscommon last time and not easy to make a case for.
runners.comment: Tailed-off on hurdles debut at Roscommon last time and not easy to make a case for

runners.name: Gethegoodtimesroll
runners.spotlight: Maiden in all disciplines ran his best race over hurdles at Tramore last winter on soft; recent point form is off-putting.
runners.comment: Maiden in all disciplines and recent point form is offputting

runners.name: A Mayo Breeze
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two maiden hurdles, including over 2m4f here last time; needs loads more, even in this weak race.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two maiden hurdles including over 2m4f here last time; needs loads more

races.race_name: Racing TV Irish EBF Mares Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Crystabel
runners.spotlight: Has shown improved form in her three maiden hurdle runs this season, two of them over C&D on good; third here and at Ballinrobe before a 10.5l sixth of 16 here last time; needs to find more on handicap bow.
runners.comment: Placed in maidens this season including here; needs to find more on h'cap bow
runners.owner: M R D Fleming & G Bruce & J P Ryan & Miss G Ryan

runners.name: Radar Ahead
runners.spotlight: Won this race last year off 6lb lower (good) under O'Keeffe; made the frame a couple of times on the Flat this year; unseated at the first when joint-favourite at Downpatrick last month; didn't improve for 3m1f trip at Bellewstown last time; remains of interest.
runners.comment: Last year's winner off 6lb lower under O'Keeffe; some okay form this term; interesting

runners.name: Kenisa Sport
runners.spotlight: Downpatrick bumper (2m2f, good) and Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner (2m, good) was turned over at short odds in a Perth mares' novice when last seen in September; lacks a recent run, so market can guide as to her fitness.
runners.comment: Bumper/hurdles winner lacks a recent run and was beaten at odds-on when last seen

runners.name: Keilah
runners.spotlight: 1-21 on the Flat, although placed on several occasions; her C&D maiden hurdle run here (good) last time wasn't too encouraging; makes handicap hurdle debut now but others make more appeal.
runners.comment: 1-21 on Flat but placed several times; C&D m'den hurdle run last time not encouraging

runners.name: Splashing Out
runners.spotlight: Lost her way before showing signs of a return to form at Downpatrick in May and proved it wasn't a false dawn when comfortably winning a six-runner contest at Tramore later that month (2m, good); she had an easy lead that day and is up 6lb, so may find the follow-up difficult.
runners.comment: Got an easy lead when winning last time; may find follow-up difficult off 6lb higher

runners.name: Doyen Magic
runners.spotlight: Won a Limerick handicap hurdle in November (2m, heavy) off 87 and has been trying to double her chase tally since; some decent runs in defeat, but those comments don't apply to her two most recent outings on better ground; reverts to hurdles now, but probably wants it softer.
runners.comment: Won on heavy in November off 87 and has been chasing since; wants it softer

runners.name: Albatala
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on the Flat with a bang at Down Royal last month when pulverising the field by 12l (10.5f, soft); attractive hurdles mark based on that performance, but this good ground is a significant question mark.
runners.comment: Won by 12l on the Flat last time; attractive hurdles mark now but gd ground a question

runners.name: Steps In The Sand
runners.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner has scored twice over hurdles, one of them coming at this venue over 2m4f; middling Flat efforts on her first two runs this year, but better at Downpatrick back over hurdles last month when a distant fourth (2m6f, good); others preferred; 1lb wrong.
runners.comment: Middling Flat efforts this year before distant fourth over hurdles last time

runners.name: Our Lucky Lady
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden hurdle here easily last October (good to yielding); bagged a brace of Flat wins in her two most recent runs at Down Royal (2m, good) and Limerick (2m1f, yielding) following the addition of a hood (retained); needs to be on the shortlist.
runners.comment: C&D m'den hurdle winner here and has bagged a brace of Flat wins last twice; shortlisted

runners.name: Beauforts Storm
runners.spotlight: Bumper and hurdles winner has been disappointing overall over fences and in one hurdle run this year, except for when second of six over fences at Tramore (2m, good) on penultimate; others are more appealing.
runners.comment: Bumper/hurdles winner has been disappointing overall this year; others more appealing

races.race_name: Foley's Bar & Off Licence Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Tell Us This
runners.spotlight: Won a Tramore claimer comfortably in April and was a decent third in a Downpatrick handicap since for this yard; raised 1lb and can go well again.
runners.comment: Won a Tramore claimer in April and decent third in a D'patrick h'cap since; can go well

runners.name: Dairy Force
runners.spotlight: Hasn't added to his maiden hurdle success for Liam O'Brien, but some good runs in defeat lately, including at Limerick last time when the winner raced on a faster strip of ground; a player.
runners.comment: Hasn't added to his maiden hurdle success but some good runs in defeat lately; a player

runners.name: Bridgehead
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner in July 2024; best effort after return from an absence was last time at Downpatrick; can be involved with a repeat raised 1lb.
runners.comment: Best effort after return from an absence was last time at Downpatrick; can be involved

runners.name: Wolf Prince
runners.spotlight: Last hurdles win came in April 2024 when trained by Fergal O'Brien; came back from a long absence for a new yard in the spring and not a bad Flat run last time, so looks a player with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Last hurdle win came in April 2024; not a bad Flat run last time and looks a player

runners.name: Mary's Pride
runners.spotlight: Was third over 2m at Ballinrobe but might have found 2m3f too far at Punchestown since; record of 2-23 over hurdles, so others preferred.
runners.comment: Third over 2m at Ballinrobe but might have found 2m3f too far at Punchestown since

runners.name: Stormbreaker
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner for Wilie Mullins ran well in some handicaps, but was below form when last seen; needs his best on return for a new yard.
runners.comment: Maiden winner for Wilie Mullins was below form when last seen; needs best on return

runners.name: Maxwell Smart
runners.spotlight: Best hurdle run came when third at Downpatrick last time in this sphere, but was poor on the Flat since, so has to put that effort behind him.
runners.comment: Best hurdle run came when 3rd at Downpatrick last time; poor on the Flat since
runners.owner: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Synd'/D O'Leary/J McNally

runners.name: Phoenix Arizona
runners.spotlight: Maiden in all spheres ran well enough in a C&D claimer last time; needs a fair bit more from 4lb out of the handicap; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Maiden ran well enough in a C&D claimer last time; needs more from 4lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Grange Walk
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner has won over fences here and has run well in defeat over hurdles here too; solid runs lately over hurdles and fences, so can be a player.
runners.comment: Won over fences here and has run well in defeat over hurdles here too; solid runs lately

runners.name: Cappucino
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner was mostly chasing without winning last term; posted a decent hurdling return at Listowel and the third home that day since won a nice pot at Bellewstown; can go well.
runners.comment: Mostly chasing without winning last term; decent hurdling return at Listowel; can go well

runners.name: One Last Tango
runners.spotlight: The last of three hurdle wins came in 2023; some good runs over fences in the last two seasons without winning; needs best hurdles form, but is off a low mark.
runners.comment: Some good runs over fences in the last two seasons without winning; needs best hurdle form

runners.name: Listentillitellyea
runners.spotlight: Maiden over fences and just 1-21 over hurdles; well beaten over fences lately and others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Just 1-21 over hurdles; well beaten over fences lately and others make more appeal

races.race_name: Kilcawley Construction Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: Andyourbirdcansing
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle here in 2024 (2m2f, good); okay return at Clonmel in May when fifth of 16 (2m4f, good to yielding); 2m6f perhaps too far at Ballinrobe and Downpatrick recently.
runners.comment: M'den hurdle winner here in 2024; 2m6f seemed too far for her last twice

runners.name: Pahlavi
runners.spotlight: 1-22 over hurdles with the win coming at Downpatrick last August off 3lb higher (2m2f, good); poor in four runs this season; blinkers go on but he's opposable.
runners.comment: 1-22 over hurdles and poor in four runs this term; opposable

runners.name: Pourquoi Poi
runners.spotlight: Won a Punchestown handicap hurdle (2m4f, good) in October off 87; decent third on handicap chase debut at Punchestown in June (3m1f, good to yielding), outstayed late on; brought down at the sixth back over hurdles at Bellewstown earlier this month; chance if none the worse eight days later.
runners.comment: Won off 87 in Oct; BD last time but he has a chance if none the worse eight days later

runners.name: Tomas O Maille
runners.spotlight: Only one win from 27 starts over hurdles, at Ballinrobe last year off 9lb higher (2m6f, good); well below his best in three runs this season, including over C&D in May.
runners.comment: 1-27 and way below his best in three runs this season, inc' over C&D

runners.name: Las Brisas Boy
runners.spotlight: Best effort over hurdles came at Punchestown in May when a 7.25l fifth of 19 (2m, good to yielding); below that level at Tramore next time (2m, good); cheekpieces are added to the tongue tie now.
runners.comment: Best effort over hurdles was a 7.25l fifth in May; not at same level last time
runners.owner: Anthony Vaughan & Mark Phillips & D P Gaffney

runners.name: Annarubyrose
runners.spotlight: Third in a C&D maiden last year for Gavin Cromwell; fair recent form for this yard, twice over 2m6f at Downpatrick.
runners.comment: Third in a C&D m'den last year and fair recent form over 2m6f at D'patrick

runners.name: Mickey Cohen
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m2f beginners' chase at Downpatrick (yielding) last autumn; placed over hurdles on either side of that success; might need this on his first run back after a lengthy break.
runners.comment: Good hurdles/chase form last autumn; might need this after a lengthy break

runners.name: Leo Messy
runners.spotlight: Impossible to fancy based on his three maiden hurdle runs, all coming on softer; tongue tie goes on now.
runners.comment: Impossible to fancy based on his three m'den runs on sft; tongue tie goes on

runners.name: Coole Vision
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; returned from almost three years away when pulled up in a point in February; weakened gradually into tenth of 16 on return to rules here last month (2m2f, good).
runners.comment: Reserve; returned to rules after a mammoth absence here when tenth of 16 latest

runners.name: At The Wings
runners.spotlight: No show in maidens and similar story in three handicaps, the latest of which at Fairyhouse in November where he was tailed off; may need more time.
runners.comment: No show in maidens and similar story in three handicaps; may need more time

runners.name: The Eggler
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over C&D on seasonal return here in May (good); up 5lb in the ratings, while his 5lb claimer has also been replaced; nonetheless, he took a couple of bumps in the course of his win and may improve for that first run back too; big player.
runners.comment: C&D winner on seasonal return; up 5lb and claimer is replaced but he's a big player

runners.name: Coup d'Essay
runners.spotlight: No impact in maidens and his three handicap outings haven't been anything to shout about; down 4lb compared to his opening mark, but could probably do with a bit more clemency.
runners.comment: No impact in three h'caps; down 4lb from initial mark but may need further clemency

runners.name: Danesfort Mayfly
runners.spotlight: Won at Tramore (2m5f, soft to heavy) on final start in 2024; off for a year before three poor runs in December/January; tough task against that background.
runners.comment: Won final 2024 start but has been poor in three runs since return from a year off

runners.name: Lost Features
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form; beaten 32l and 44l since entering handicap company.
runners.comment: Ordinary form; beaten 32l and 44l since entering handicap company
runners.owner: Profit In Your Pocket Racing Club

runners.name: Art Of Silence
runners.spotlight: Won a bumper and a maiden hurdle at Ballinrobe, but that latest win came three years ago; was in poor form over hurdles last autumn and was tailed off on his chasing debut at Downpatrick back from a break; the blinkers are new.
runners.comment: Bumper/m'den hurdle winner but nothing since 2023; poor recent form

runners.name: Lord De Choisel
runners.spotlight: First reserve; well beaten in three maiden hurdles on softer conditions; hopes rest on better ground, a new tongue tie and handicaps getting more from him.
runners.comment: Reserve; well beaten in three m'dens on sft; makes h'cap bow in a tongue tie

runners.name: Echinacea
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; 17-race maiden; best of three runs over hurdles came when a 12.5l fourth at Downpatrick in May; may improve for switch to handicaps.
runners.comment: Reserve; 17-race m'den ran okay in the second of her three runs over hurdles; h'cap debut

races.race_name: Kilcawley Construction Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Finnicky Filly
runners.spotlight: Hard to win with but not in bad form by any means, over hurdles and fences; 2m6f at Roscommon (yielding to soft) was likely too far for her last time.
runners.comment: Hard to win with but not in bad form; 2m6f last time was likely too far for her

runners.name: Ladiam
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; both wins came over C&D, the latest of which came last summer off this mark (good); okay fifth here on return (2m4f, good) but distant fifth at Ballinrobe last time.
runners.comment: Reserve; dual C&D winner inc' off this mark; distant fifth at Ballinrobe last time

runners.name: Saint Peregrine
runners.spotlight: Lost form after finishing second in a maiden hurdle at this venue last summer; continued poor run of form when well beaten over 2m2f here on seasonal return (good) last month.
runners.comment: Lost form after finishing second here last year; well beaten on seasonal return here

runners.name: Mother Ship
runners.spotlight: First reserve; 0-19 under rules and again showed little on chase debut at Tramore.
runners.comment: Reserve; 0-19 under rules and again showed little on chase debut at Tramore

runners.name: Lilac Lady
runners.spotlight: Flat maiden has run well at times over hurdles, particularly at this track; most recently was fourth in maiden hurdle company (2m2f, good); tongue-tie goes on and she should give a good account of herself.
runners.comment: Flat maiden has run well over hurdles here recently; should give a good account again

runners.name: Dream Shaper
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in 26 starts; ninth of 13 at Limerick last time (2m, soft, 33-1); unlikely.
runners.comment: Unplaced in 26 starts; ninth of 13 at Limerick last time (2m, soft, 33-1); unlikely

runners.name: Larkins Lane
runners.spotlight: Narrowly got off the mark at Limerick (2m4f, soft) and continued the winning thread over C&D (good) next time when 2.75l ahead of the rest, keeping on well; up 7lb more and riders' claim reduced since, but big chance of making it a three-timer.
runners.comment: On course for three-timer after wins at Limerick and over C&D; up 7lb more but big chance

runners.name: Mr Erwitt
runners.spotlight: Very modest form in maidens and pulled up in both handicaps; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Very modest form in maidens and pulled up in both handicaps; hard to fancy

runners.name: Poppycon
runners.spotlight: Standout run over hurdles when a good second in a novice handicap at Wexford in March (2m, soft) on handicap debut; beaten when a faller over 2m4f at Tramore next time and was a distant fourth at Listowel last time; cheekpieces are added to the tongue tie but he may want it softer.
runners.comment: Good second on h'cap debut on sft; hasn't matched that in two runs on better ground since

runners.name: Sekifi
runners.spotlight: Has never reached the first three, but two okay hurdling runs recently sandwich a poor Limerick effort; others preferred.
runners.comment: Has never reached the first three but some okay runs recently

runners.name: Go To Town
runners.spotlight: Posted some okay efforts in maiden hurdles last summer; tailed off on handicap/stable debut in May, but much better at Clonmel when a 3.5l fourth (2m1f, good); shaped like a return to this sort of trip would suit better that day.
runners.comment: Good fourth last time, when shaping like a return to this sort of trip would help

runners.name: Tellmemamema
runners.spotlight: Outran 80-1 odds at Down Royal (2m2f, good) on handicap debut in May when fourth of 20, staying on well; a bit below that when a 19l fifth of 18 at Listowel (2m5f, good to yielding); place chance.
runners.comment: Outran 80-1 odds when fourth on handicap bow; a bit below that last time

runners.name: Poetic Focus
runners.spotlight: Much better, compared to her return, at Bellewstown last time when a 12.5l fifth of 15; others more likely.
runners.comment: 12.5l fifth of 15 on second run this season at Bellewstown; others more likely

runners.name: Cornaroya Rocco
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; okay efforts in his final two maidens, but he was pulled up on his handicap debut at Ballinrobe.
runners.comment: Reserve; okay efforts in his final two m'dens but PU on h'cap bow

runners.name: Cherry Red
runners.spotlight: Surprise winner of a 2m2f maiden (good, 28-1) here last month having failed to complete her three previous point-to-point starts; the form probably doesn't amount to much, but entitled to respect all the same.
runners.comment: Surprise m'den winner here last time; form doesn't amount to much but entitled to respect

runners.name: Frontier Rose
runners.spotlight: Modest form in bumpers and maiden hurdles for her previous trainer; not much better for her new yard, beaten 19l at Clonmel last month.
runners.comment: Modest form for previous trainer and not much better for new yard

runners.name: Fine Print
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner was fourth behind an easy winner on his second handicap hurdle start at Wexford in May (2m1f, good to yielding); never better than midfield on the Flat at Down Royal later that month.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner was fourth behind an easy winner on second h'cap hurdle start in May

runners.name: Papagei
runners.spotlight: Three-time British Flat winner for James Ferguson; no wins since 2024; enters handicap hurdle company for the first time now following moderate efforts in four maidens; best watched.
runners.comment: Three-time British Flat winner is best watched following moderate m'den hurdle form

races.race_name: Sligo Park Hotel Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Evans Secret
runners.spotlight: One of three for trainer; off the mark when winning this race last year (good); nearly made it back-to-back C&D victories when beaten a neck on seasonal return in May (good, 11-1); up 2lb but he should come on for that run and O'Keeffe now rides for the first time.
runners.comment: Won this race last year and returned with a neck defeat here last time; big player

runners.name: Ballagh Star
runners.spotlight: Both his chase wins have come at this track over 3m2f on better ground; two runs since returning to action have not been inspiring, tailed off over hurdles at Punchestown and pulled up over fences at Roscommon.
runners.comment: Both chase wins have come at this track but two runs since returning have not been good

runners.name: Tango Theatre
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; sole success in 26 hurdle starts came over C&D in August off 6lb lower when winning by 15l (good); should come on for creditable fifth on return at Kilbeggan.
runners.comment: 1-26 over hurdles but the win came over C&D by 15l last August off 6lb lower

runners.name: Wild Mandate
runners.spotlight: One of three for trainer; placed in four bumpers and took the runner-up spot over 2m2f here on handicap debut in August (good); weakened into fifth of 12 on return at Downpatrick (2m3f, good) last month; questions at this trip as she was well beaten over 2m5f at Limerick in October (yielding).
runners.comment: Runner-up here on h'cap bow in Aug'; query as to whether she wants this trip

runners.name: Smallcraftwarning
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner and has won a chase; never better than midfield here last month (3m2f, good), but much better at Limerick (2m7f, good) last time when a 2.75l runner-up; could build on that.
runners.comment: Midfield here last month but much better at Limerick when runner-up; chance

runners.name: Golden Temple
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner reverts to this sphere after not distinguishing himself over fences most recently; others preferred.
runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner reverts to this sphere after not distinguishing himself over fences

runners.name: Joe's Turn
runners.spotlight: One of three for trainer; got a first hurdles win at Kilbeggan in April last year off 9lb lower (3m1f, yielding); well beaten on return at Punchestown in May, but that was his first run in nine months, so entitled to come on for it.
runners.comment: Won off 9lb lower at Kilbeggan last year; entitled to come on for moderate return latest

runners.name: Le Grand Vert
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form when adding a fourth chase win at Punchestown in June (3m1f, good to yielding); another good run at Cartmel last time when beaten a neck; reverts to hurdles now off a much lower mark, but hasn't been able to take advantage of it in the past; 2lb wrong.
runners.comment: Added fourth chase win before beaten a neck latest; reverts to hurdles off much lower mark

runners.name: Je Suis
runners.spotlight: Point winner ran her best race under rules when a 3.5l third of 16 over 3m2f here last month (good, 40-1); the form of that race might not be trustworthy, though, as the race turned into a dash.
runners.comment: Ran her best race when third of 16 here last time but the form may not be trustworthy

runners.name: Strong Contender
runners.spotlight: Ran her best race upon switching to handicaps at Kilbeggan last time when a 10.5l seventh of 15 (2m1f, good to yielding), left with plenty to do before keeping on; tongue tie goes on now; 3lb wrong
runners.comment: Ran best race on h'cap bow when seventh of 15, keeping on; tongue tie goes on now

runners.name: Kazbek
runners.spotlight: Has been showing a fair standard over hurdles, making the frame in three of his last four outings in this sphere; his chasing debut didn't go to plan when last seen in January; in the mix if picking up where he left off over hurdles.
runners.comment: Placed a couple of times over hurdles before PU on chase debut; in the mix at his best

runners.name: Kalanisi Flash
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; maiden winner over 2m6f over two years ago; has only run three times since then and the two most recent of those have seen him pull up.
runners.comment: Maiden winner has been PU in his last two runs; others preferred

runners.name: Sphagnum
runners.spotlight: Lost his form badly after winning the Cork National in 2024, but bounced back over 3m2f here (good) last time in first-time blinkers when runner-up after idling when leading (1.75l ahead of Je Suis); form of that race is questionable, but he has a notably low hurdles mark if he can repeat that effort.
runners.comment: Back to form when second here last time in first-time blinkers; low mark if he can repeat

runners.name: Justatan
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in two point-to-points for Michael Goff; disappointing since, including on handicap debut at Naas in January, but first try at this trip and the addition of a tongue-tie could unlock improvement; interesting if the market speaks in his favour.
runners.comment: First try at this trip after disappointing over shorter; interesting if strong in market

runners.name: Cornmarket
runners.spotlight: All three hurdling wins have come here (two over 2m4f and one at this trip); well backed on the Flat here in May but was well beaten (1m6f, yielding to soft); 8lb above last winning mark, but not ruled out back over hurdles.
runners.comment: All three hurdles wins came here; 8lb above last winning mark but not ruled out
runners.owner: John J Cullen & Michael C Barrett

runners.name: Back The West
runners.spotlight: Reserve; 0-25 and pulled up in two handicap starts this year; doesn't inspire confidence; 12lb wrong.
runners.comment: Reserve; 0-25 and pulled up in two handicaps starts this year; 12lb wrong

runners.name: Streets Of Doyen
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner but his best years are behind him; beaten 21l on stable debut last month.
runners.comment: Seven-time winner but his best years are behind him

races.race_name: Clayton Hotel Mares INH Flat Race

runners.name: Moyneard
runners.spotlight: Solid efforts all six bumper starts including over C&D last time; has 2.25l to find on Circus Hill from that run, but is likely to be involved again.
runners.comment: Has 2.25l to find on Circus Hill from last run but is likely to be involved again

runners.name: Circus Hill
runners.spotlight: Represents a local yard and her best runs have come over C&D, notably last time when was 2.25l in front of Moyneard; should uphold that form and doesn't need much more to take this.
runners.comment: Best run came when 2nd over C&D last time and doesn't need much more to take this
runners.owner: Dermot J Kelly & E J Burns & Sandra C Kelly

runners.name: Churchfield Annie
runners.spotlight: Fine runs in defeat in three out of her four bumper starts; her poor run came in Listed company on testing ground last November; the tongue-tie worn on return at Downpatrick is retained; solid chance.
runners.comment: Fine runs in three out of four bumpers; tongue-tie worn last time retained; solid chance

runners.name: Clovelly Charm
runners.spotlight: Has a decent pedigree and caught the eye when staying on to be 5l behind Circus Hill over C&D on debut; there should be a decent bit of improvement to come and is in the mix.
runners.comment: Was 5l behind Circus Hill over C&D on debut; with improvement to come should be in the mix

runners.name: Hill Of Ballyline
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to winners Yeats Star (useful for this yard; 2m-2m6f hurdle/chase) and Chosen Thyme (bumper); dam fell in a point, is granddaughter of 2m5f-3m1f chase winner; related to some decent sorts and is one to consider, with the market a help.
runners.comment: Related to some decent sorts and is one to consider, with the market a help

runners.name: Carleys Lilly
runners.spotlight: Solid fourth in a 2m Clonmel maiden hurdle on debut and might not have stayed 2m4f at Limerick since; of some interest down in trip, reverting to a bumper.
runners.comment: Solid hurdle run over 2m on debut; might not have stayed 2m4f since; of some interest

runners.name: Saoirses Choice
runners.spotlight: Beaten 15l on soft ground in a Limerick bumper on debut; a lesser effort at Punchestown on good since; has to do much more.
runners.comment: Promise on debut but a lesser effort since and has to do much more

runners.name: Maple Mornin
runners.spotlight: Second foal; half-sister to point winner Syr Maffos; dam 2m4f-3m hunter chase/prolific point winner, out of unraced half-sister to prolific 7f-1m4f winner Rashay; likely one to watch for future reference on debut.
runners.comment: Likely one to watch for future reference on debut

runners.name: Allez Yeats
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to useful bumper and 2m1f-2m6f hurdle/chase winner Tesseract; dam unraced half-sister to Italian 1m3f Listed winner Apprimus; by a useful sire and from a dual-purpose pedigree; could go well on debut.
runners.comment: By a useful sire and from a dual-purpose pedigree; could go well on debut

runners.name: Wild Eagle
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in three bumpers, including twice over C&D; the addition of a hood will need to make a major impact.
runners.comment: Well beaten in three bumpers; the addition of a hood will need to make a major impact

runners.name: Lexenna
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a Limerick bumper on debut and has to make a lot of improvement.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a Limerick bumper on debut and has to make a lot of improvement

runners.name: Mila Ballerina
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers, including in a visor at Bellewstown last week; this is a lesser race, but still needs loads more.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a visor at Bellewstown last week; this is weaker but still needs loads more

races.race_name: Ladies Day At Dundalk Handicap

runners.name: Kerdos
runners.spotlight: Won four for Clive Cox, including the Group 2 Temple Stakes at Haydock in 2024, his last victory; yet to hit those heights for this yard and has been soundly beaten on his last three starts; 0-2 on the AW but did run well here behind Valiant Force in February; blinkers replace cheekpieces worn last time.
runners.comment: Smart form for Clive Cox, below best on last three starts, 0-2 on AW, blinkers now tried
runners.owner: Michael Scaife/Liam Ferguson/Simon Murphy/H S Khunkhuna

runners.name: Ipanema Queen
runners.spotlight: Scored in Listed company over C&D last October; narrowly denied over 6f here in March; solid efforts in hot turf handicaps the last twice and preferred by Egan but likely to face competition for the early lead here from Eclairage and Rosie Frith; drawn wide.
runners.comment: C&D listed win in October, solid efforts on turf last twice, preferred by Egan, drawn wide
runners.owner: Stonestreet Stables, LLC & AMO Racing Limited

runners.name: The Highway Rat
runners.spotlight: Back on song when just failing to reel in the winner at Navan on latest; four C&D wins to his name, including a Group 3, and is 5lb better off for a 1.75l defeat behind Valiant Force in a rated race here in February; third in this last year and should go well again.
runners.comment: Four-time C&D winner, back to form at Navan latest, should go well again

runners.name: Rosie Frith
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in October off 13lb lower; poor on first two starts this season but roared back to form to make all at Bellewstown 10 days ago (5f, good); career-high mark now but this 3yo could have more to offer and top rider booked; player.
runners.comment: C&D winner, back to form at Bellewstown latest, may have more to offer, top rider booked

runners.name: Eclairage
runners.spotlight: Speedy filly has an excellent strike rate over C&D (4-6) including this race last year off 2lb lower; went close behind Howd'yadoit at Navan in May but has failed to fire in three runs since; return to this track offers hope of a revival and cheekpieces are added; bold bid likely from plum draw.
runners.comment: Went close at Navan in May, poor since but is 4-6 over this C&D, won this last year

runners.name: Final Melody
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; finished off last year in fine form at this venue, backing up her C&D handicap win with a short-head second in a conditions race over C&D when last seen in December; is 4lb wrong here, however, and lacks a recent run so is probably best watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: C&D winner, in fine form when last seen in Dec', 4lb wrong here, prob' best watched
runners.owner: Gary Devlin & Kevin Osborne & N W T Dalzell & Tracey Wylie

runners.name: Fox In Flight
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden over C&D last December and overall form figures here read 2313; not as consistent on turf this season; ran well at Cork in June but down the field on latest at the Curragh; another one that could potentially improve now returned to the AW, but he's 4lb wrong here.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner goes well here, poor on turf latest but could rebound, 4lb wrong

runners.name: Collective Power
runners.spotlight: Six-time course winner, including twice over C&D, but his last four wins here have come over 6f; however, he did go close off this mark over C&D in May and should get a strong pace to aim at; not out of this.
runners.comment: Six-time course winner, went close over C&D in May, same mark here, not out of this
runners.owner: Exors of the Late Mrs S Power

runners.name: Howd'yadoit
runners.spotlight: 3yo landed the third win of his career when beating Eclairage by a head at Navan in May (5f, yielding); has been beaten in conditions races twice since and is 7lb higher on return to handicap company; sole previous AW run wasn't his best, but his yard is red-hot so can't discount.
runners.comment: Beat Eclairage by a head at Navan in May, 7lb higher here, yard in red hot form

runners.name: Valiant Force
runners.spotlight: Struggling on turf this season but won his last start over C&D in February and, overall, he has won five times at this venue over a variety of trips; second behind Eclairage in this last season; a return to form would come as no surprise but David Egan prefers Ipanema Queen.
runners.comment: Struggling on turf recently, has won five times at this venue, Egan prefers Ipanema Queen
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

races.race_name: RACING TV FREE ONE MONTH TRIAL Handicap

runners.name: Fate's Gambit
runners.spotlight: Best effort came on debut over C&D in January; five starts since (four on turf) have not been at the same level and never involved when 33-1 on handicap debut at Gowran last month; blinkers tried that day are left off here.
runners.comment: Failed to build on promising debut C&D effort, soundly beaten on h'cap debut latest
runners.owner: Gary Devlin & N W T Dalzell

runners.name: Bullet Bourbon
runners.spotlight: Twelve-race maiden ran one of her better races when runner-up over 6f here in April off 56; soundly beaten on turf in four runs since, but now 4lb lower than she was for that April run and not dismissed back at this venue.
runners.comment: 0-12, runner up here in April off 4lb higher, poor on turf since but could revive
runners.owner: David Daly & Gerard Shevlin & D Battersby

runners.name: Gonna Be Golden
runners.spotlight: Won fillies' maiden over C&D in December; back to form with a 1l third of seven at Down Royal on latest (5f, soft); return to 7f and this surface are positives; player.
runners.comment: C&D winner, back to form on turf latest (5f), return to 7f and AW a plus, player

runners.name: Kc Bear
runners.spotlight: Has held form well since sent handicapping; won off 6lb lower over 6f here in December; beaten 0.5l off this mark over 1m here in March; solid efforts over 7f and 8.5f at Fairyhouse the last twice; place claims at the very least.
runners.comment: Consistent in handicaps, course winner over 6f, place claims at the very least

runners.name: Whistling Jamesie
runners.spotlight: Won on handicap debut here over 6f off 1lb higher, but that is starting to look like a flash in the pan; poor form otherwise and soundly beaten all three starts this season; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Won on handicap debut over 6f here last year, poor form otherwise and others appeal more

runners.name: Push Harder
runners.spotlight: 0-7 overall and 0-4 on AW; ran okay when a 2.75l third over 1m here in December but two runs this season have not been her best; tongue-tie now added to usual hood; more needed and is 5lb wrong.
runners.comment: 0-7, ran okay over 1m here in December, poor twice since, new headgear combo tried

runners.name: Sagasti
runners.spotlight: Maiden was a close third in a fillies' maiden over C&D in December on final start for Sheila Lavery; mixed bag on turf in three starts for this stable; ran well at Gowran on penultimate outing but never figured in visor (retained) at Fairyhouse on latest.
runners.comment: Ran well over C&D in Dec', mixed bag on turf this season, well beaten latest at Fairyhouse

runners.name: Iff In Doubt
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in February off 8lb lower; beaten less than 2l in a big field at the Curragh on latest (6f, good), staying on well, and eased 1lb for that effort; return to 7f on the AW could enable him to get his head back in front; leading claims.
runners.comment: C&D winner, fine run over 6f on turf latest, step back up to 7f a plus, leading claims

runners.name: Mountain Memory
runners.spotlight: Didn't achieve much in three turf maidens at 6f-7f on varying ground; could do better now tackling a handicap, and worth checking in the market.
runners.comment: No impact in trio of turf maidens at, potential improver on h'cap debut, check market

runners.name: Reimagined
runners.spotlight: 6f Windsor novice winner for former yard; three turf runs for this yard have all been at that trip and yet to get closer than 4l to the winner; mark sliding but unproven on this surface, and others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Yet to get closer than 4l to the winner in three runs for this yard, AW debut

runners.name: Wild Berries
runners.spotlight: Pretty modest form in maidens and no sign of progress in first two handicaps; never figured on seasonal return at the Curragh and now makes AW debut; not easy to fancy.
runners.comment: Modest maiden form, no impact in first two handicaps, AW debut, hard to fancy

races.race_name: Anglo Printers - Award Winning Print And Packaging Maiden

runners.name: Krasimir
runners.spotlight: Never worse than third in six starts, over this trip last twice; tongue-tie returns for AW debut and plenty of horses by Mehmas win on synthetic surfaces.
runners.comment: Never worse than third in six starts, over this trip last twice; tongue-tied for AW debut

runners.name: Karrygrant
runners.spotlight: Placed four times from six starts on turf, including when nailed on the line at Bellewstown having tried to make all; reckon he'll be in the front rank again with cheekpieces now fitted, after another solid run at the Curragh; sire was classy turf horse in the US, yet to sire AW winner from limited runners; dam did win on AW.
runners.comment: Placed four times from six starts; reckon he'll be prominent, with cheekpieces now fitted

runners.name: Outlaw Man
runners.spotlight: Mark of 78 after three C&D runs, but remains to be seen if he merits that rating because it's winter form; hung right the first day and missed the break in a hood last time, so he might have a few quirks, but right man on board to sort him out.
runners.comment: Mark of 78 after three C&D runs; might have a few quirks, but right man on board

runners.name: Rock Of Claremont
runners.spotlight: Profitable gelding with an interesting pedigree; closely related to a Godolphin Group 1-winning 2yo and half-brother to Heavy Metal, a prolific winner on the dirt at Meydan; 16s, got tired late on when fifth over 1m at The Curragh, 5l off third-placed Karrygrant.
runners.comment: Nice start when fifth over 1m at The Curragh, 5l off third-placed Karrygrant.

runners.name: My Shayla
runners.spotlight: Phoenix Of Spain filly cost E13,000 as a yearling and sports a tongue-tie for debut; related to three prolific and useful winners, two of them on AW.
runners.comment: Phoenix Of Spain filly is related to three prolific and useful winners, two of them on AW

runners.name: Mr Mercury
runners.spotlight: Homebred son of The Gurkha; half-brother to 8.6f/1m4f winner Space Kid (inc AW/Belgium); unraced dam out of Group-placed 1m1f winning half-sister to 1m1f/1m2f Listed winner Livadiya; trainer doesn't have debut winners.
runners.comment: Homebred son of The Gurkha; half-brother to 8.6f/1m4f winner Space Kid (inc AW/Belgium)

runners.name: Carry The Dream
runners.spotlight: Didn't make it to the breeze-ups after costing 40,000gns as a yearling; half-brother to 7f Group 3 winner Breathtaking Look (also won on AW) and to two other winners; dam Listed-placed 1m-9.4f AW winner; not hard to see him running well.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 7f Group 3 winner Breathtaking Look (also won on AW); dam won on AW

runners.name: King Of Eze
runners.spotlight: Boiled over, bolted to post and unseated rider before Curragh debut, where he ran keen and dropped out to finish in rear (Karrygrant third); hood now on.
runners.comment: Bolted to post and unseated rider before Curragh debut, where he ran keen and weakened

runners.name: Lilbittyprettyone
runners.spotlight: Starman filly had three turf runs over 5f last year, modest enough form; dam was placed on AW in France; 10 months off and McAteer on stablemate.
runners.comment: Starman filly had three turf runs over 5f last year, modest form; McAteer on stablemate

runners.name: Ask Me Again
runners.spotlight: Well-bred son of Palace Pier; 18s for Curragh debut over extended 6f, trailed home in rear after a slow start.
runners.comment: 18s for Curragh debut over extended 6f, trailed home in rear after a slow start

races.race_name: QuinnBet Handicap

runners.name: Cosmic Force
runners.spotlight: Maiden not beaten far a few times here earlier in the year, over trips between 6f-1m; likely to find a few too strong but minor place claims.
runners.comment: Maiden not beaten far a few times here earlier in the year, over trips between 6f-1m

runners.name: Bella Colombia
runners.spotlight: Defied a similarly-wide draw when winning over C&D in March; only 1lb higher now and little wrong with her turf form since.
runners.comment: Defied a similarly-wide draw when winning over C&D in March; only 1lb higher now

runners.name: Desert Of The Sea
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; maiden was runner-up over 7f and 1m here earlier in the year, behind Bella Colombia on the latter occasion in March; poor run at Bellewstown latest.
runners.comment: Maiden was runner-up over 7f and 1m here earlier in the year; reserve

runners.name: Fleetfootsoldier
runners.spotlight: Four wins here, three of them over this trip, and may step up on recent turf efforts which were probably with a view to getting him fit for AW action.
runners.comment: Four wins here, three of them over this trip, and may step up on recent turf efforts

runners.name: Roman Harry
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; won a 7f claimer here in December and some fair runs in 7f/1m course handicaps in the spring.
runners.comment: Won a 7f claimer here in December and some fair runs in handicaps since; reserve

runners.name: Rockbury Lad
runners.spotlight: Has winning and placed form over C&D, but has a habit of starting slowly which has been evident on turf lately; placed on last two visits here earlier this year.
runners.comment: Has winning and placed form over C&D, but has a habit of starting slowly
runners.owner: P E Ryan & J G Shanahan

runners.name: Micasso
runners.spotlight: One good run last year and popped up at 22-1 on return at Bellewstown; burst here on a previous visit and making a quick return to action, so the 'bounce factor' sirens are sounding.
runners.comment: One good run last year and popped up at 22-1 on return at Bellewstown

runners.name: Akashaa
runners.spotlight: Went close from a wide draw over C&D last August; should come on from fair seasonal debut over 1m1f at Leopardstown where she was disputing the lead a furlong down; this is only her fifth start in handicaps.
runners.comment: Should come on from fair seasonal debut at Leopardstown and went close over C&D last year

runners.name: Movin And Groovin
runners.spotlight: Winner over 6f here and twice placed over this trip; been off 14 months and new stable (same owners)
runners.comment: Winner over 6f here and twice placed over this trip; been off 14 months and new stable

runners.name: Kitty Bear
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in the winter and has added two wins on turf; likes a bit of space, so draw is okay, but she might be high enough in the handicap now.
runners.comment: C&D winner in the winter and has added two wins on turf; likes a bit of space, so draw ok
runners.owner: Charles Kerwin & Brendan Kerwin & Liam Kehoe

runners.name: Rampage
runners.spotlight: Won a division of this last year off a mark of 60, but has been out of form on turf this season and only mid-field when favourite over C&D in April on sole AW start in 2026.
runners.comment: Won a division of this last year, but has been out of form on turf this season
runners.owner: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Syndicate/S Sweeney

runners.name: Monroe Dasher
runners.spotlight: First reserve; never a factor in four completed starts, including on handicap debut at Limerick.
runners.comment: Never a factor in four completed starts, including on handicap debut at Limerick; reserve

runners.name: Angel Of Promise
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two turf handicaps over 6f; first run here and dam is related to AW winners; visor on and stamina to prove.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two turf handicaps over 6f; first run here, dam is related to AW winners

runners.name: Captain Ciano
runners.spotlight: Maiden was second over a longer trip on soft last year; slowly away before late headway behind Micasso at Bellewstown latest; unplaced in four runs here, albeit three of them were non-handicaps.
runners.comment: Maiden was second on soft last year; slowly away before late headway behind Micasso latest

runners.name: My Vonnie
runners.spotlight: Second over 1m4f here in November, but that's her only time to place in 10 starts here and 1m likely too sharp; another headgear combo tried, but even the champion jockey will struggle to get this one involved
runners.comment: Second over 1m4f here in November, but that's her only time to place in 10 starts here

runners.name: Navajo Point
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and back from over a year off with creditable mid-field run over this trip at Leoprdstown, keeping on steadily from off the pace; first start on AW.
runners.comment: Lightly raced and back from over a year off with creditable run on turf; first start on AW

runners.name: Famous Enough
runners.spotlight: Hold-up performer by necessity, really, as he can be tardy from the gates; C&D winner and just failed to get up here in April; only 1lb higher now and if they go hard, it will be a big help.
runners.comment: C&D winner and just failed to get up here in April; only 1lb higher now

races.race_name: Fairways Hotel Dundalk Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Rising Sky
runners.spotlight: Winner over 10.5f here in March, and good third over a similar trip at Naas last month, but 1m4f has seemed too far in three previous tries at it; seventh, beaten 9l, over 1m2f at Navan on Saturday.
runners.comment: Winner over 10.5f here, but 1m4f has seemed too far; seventh at Navan on Saturday

runners.name: Porsche Lad
runners.spotlight: Forget his two recent turf runs as they were probably preps for this; useful record here with two wins over 10.5f and some good runs over this trip.
runners.comment: Useful record here with two wins over 10.5f and some good runs over this trip

runners.name: Tero d'Rosa
runners.spotlight: Twice placed over 10.5f here in November; off the mark over 1m1f at Ballinrobe and fair runs since; hasn't gone this far before but is by a St Leger winner.
runners.comment: Twice placed over 10.5f here in November; off the mark over 1m1f at Ballinrobe; up in trip

runners.name: Grey Fable
runners.spotlight: Dual winner at Chester in 2024 and gained first AW win over C&D in May (22-1); well beaten on turf next time; due to run at Limerick on Saturday.
runners.comment: Gained first AW win over C&D in May (22-1); runs at Limerick on Saturday

runners.name: Celtic Druid
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back C&D wins under this rider in the spring and really good third in higher grade at the Curragh last time; lots to like.
runners.comment: Back-to-back C&D wins under this rider in the spring and good third at the Curragh latest

runners.name: Sonny Corleone
runners.spotlight: Nice run here over 10.5f for previous yard; having been gelded, encouraging fourth (posted wide) over same trip at Down Royal on stable debut (strong form); half-sister won three handicaps here, two of them over this trip, and Elzaams have a great record here.
runners.comment: Encouraging fourth on stable debut at Down Royal (strong form); half-sister won over C&D

runners.name: Baila Conmigo
runners.spotlight: Two wins here in the spring, including over this trip, and last couple of turf runs have been fine, 2m looking too far last time.
runners.comment: Two wins here, including over this trip, and last couple of turf runs have been fine

runners.name: Mystic Rose
runners.spotlight: Been racing prominently before weakening in her races over longer trips; cheekpieces added for first outing here and half-sister won on AW.
runners.comment: Been racing prominently before weakening in her races over longer trips; AW debut

runners.name: Chopsticks
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Sligo last summer; placed loads of times here, including over this trip in May, but burst only five days ago which makes him too risky.
runners.comment: Sole win came at Sligo last year; placed loads of times here, but burst only five days ago

runners.name: Sutton Hoo
runners.spotlight: Famous colours and he won 10.5f maiden here in February, but that's weak form and he was lapped on handicap debut at Down Royal; steps up in trip and bred for it.
runners.comment: Won 10.5f maiden here, but that's weak form; poor run in first handicap at Down Royal

runners.name: Folk Warrior
runners.spotlight: Fair fifth over C&D in May on sole AW run; did nothing in a hurry at Leopardstown (1m1f) on Thursday, but stuck to his task and not beaten far; big horse has one in him, but maybe not quite yet.
runners.comment: Fair fifth over C&D in May on sole AW run and not beaten far over 1m1f on Thursday

runners.name: Dancing Steve
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner and thrice runner-up here, including in last year's renewal; form tailed off later last year, but better for his return to action.
runners.comment: Dual turf winner and thrice runner-up here, including in last year's renewal; has had prep

runners.name: Rich Belief
runners.spotlight: AW winner at two in Britain, but has never raced here; won a claiming hurdle two runs back, but trip looks too sharp as well as the query about him on Polytrack.
runners.comment: AW winner at two in Britain, but has never raced here; won claiming hurdle two runs back

races.race_name: Border Boutique Hire Maiden

runners.name: Reynir
runners.spotlight: Progressive without winning in three maidens on turf; best effort yet over 1m2f (yielding) on latest at Navan 57 days ago; has since been gelded and cheekpieces now go on for AW debut; rated 85 and the one to beat.
runners.comment: Progressing in maidens, best effort yet on latest, gelded, cheekpieces on, the one to beat
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Police Gazette
runners.spotlight: Both starts have come here; soundly beaten on debut over 1m in April; didn't quite get home upped to 1m4f on latest when beaten 9l into third; new headgear goes on and he drops in trip; more needed.
runners.comment: Both runs here, didn't get home upped to 1m4f latest, new headgear on, more needed

runners.name: Matties Point
runners.spotlight: Almanzor gelding was a 15,000gns foal; half-brother to 7f/1m winner Beagle Bay (inc AW; RPR 101); dam Listed-placed 6f-1m winner (inc 2yo/AW; 103), half-sister to 5f 2yo winner Limetree Lady; a bit of appeal on paper and worth a market check.
runners.comment: Almanzor gelding, dam listed placed AW winner, worth a market check on debut

runners.name: Dorie Miller
runners.spotlight: Modest form in bumpers and maiden hurdles; makes Flat and AW debut; best watched.
runners.comment: AW and Flat debut, very modest bumper and hurdles form, best watched

runners.name: Let's Smash It
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 22-1 here on debut (1m) in December and found just one too good, beaten a neck into second; off since, which is slightly concerning, but pedigree suggests that this longer trip might suit and should run well again if ready after his break.
runners.comment: Promising introduction here in December, off since, trip should suit, can go well again

runners.name: Perggosa
runners.spotlight: Heavy defeats all four starts, including twice here over 7f; no improvement for step up in trip at Ballinrobe latest; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats all four starts including twice here, hard to make a case for

races.race_name: Family Funday At Dundalk Saturday 15th August Fillies Maiden

runners.name: Duvessa
runners.spotlight: Promise in all three maiden runs at 1m2f-1m5f; the latter trip on soft ground probably stretched her on latest at Down Royal; form of previous second at Roscommon (1m4f, good) looks solid in the context of this race; rated 74 and big chance if taking to this surface (half-sister won on AW).
runners.comment: Promise all three starts on turf, rated 74, big chance if taking to this surface

runners.name: Forthill
runners.spotlight: All four turf runs have come on soft and heavy ground at 1m3f-1m4f; beaten favourite when second at Killarney in October and at the Curragh in November; well below best on seasonal return at Bellewstown in April and off since; claims on best form if handling the AW.
runners.comment: Promise in two of three runs last term, poor on latest, chance on best form, AW debut

runners.name: Tequila
runners.spotlight: Showed enough to suggest she could win a race when trained in Britain; below best when last seen at Pontefract in September; has joined yard that can ready one and has run well on the AW before, so monitor the market.
runners.comment: Promise in Britain, off since poor run in September, yard can ready one, check market

runners.name: Rocket Robyn
runners.spotlight: Standout effort a head second at Gowran on third start last October (9.5f, heavy); has failed to build on that and soundly beaten in handicaps on last three starts; rated 65 and a fair bit to find on AW debut.
runners.comment: Gowran second a standout effort, poor form otherwise, rated 65, a bit to find on AW bow

runners.name: Wheres The Gold
runners.spotlight: Very modest form so far in turf maidens; beaten 29l on latest; can only be watched in first-time cheekpieces on AW debut.
runners.comment: Very modest form in turf maidens, cheekpieces on for AW bow, can only watch

runners.name: Annacroft
runners.spotlight: Heavy defeats at huge odds in maidens at Down Royal and Bellewstown; seems safe to rule out.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats at huge odds in both starts, seems safe to rule out

races.race_name: Book Your Christmas Party Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: L'Amalric
runners.spotlight: Worcester winner who was found wanting under a penalty at Uttoxeter (2m, good), though that wasn't too bad a race and the second has won since; should also improve for this longer trip with his pointing background.
runners.comment: Found wanting under a penalty at Uttoxeter but in a useful race; raised in trip

runners.name: Holy Joe
runners.spotlight: Making headway when unseating at Downpatrick (2m3f) and then made no mistake at the expense of a subsequent winner at Clonmel (2m, good); sets the standard on RPRs and Rian Corcoran's claim takes away 5lb of his penalty.
runners.comment: Sets the standard on RPRs and Rian Corcoran's claim takes away 5lb of his penalty

runners.name: Moi Mon Vieux
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in good-ground bumpers in France and at Southwell (good; tongue tied); should make a hurdler but this is no easy starter.
runners.comment: Runner-up in two bumpers; should make a hurdler but this is no easy starter

runners.name: Dolly Dior
runners.spotlight: 50-1 when scraping home in a modest 2m4f maiden at Hexham and she has more on her plate here, especially with a penalty.
runners.comment: 50-1 when scraping home in a modest 2m4f maiden at Hexham; more needed here

runners.name: Fortunes Dawn
runners.spotlight: Looks limited and was 125-1 when tailed off behind Dolly Dior at Hexham.
runners.comment: Looks limited and was 125-1 when tailed off behind Dolly Dior at Hexham

races.race_name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Conquer The Breeze
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been at Hexham and it was never in much doubt there three weeks ago (1m7f, good); hard to grumble with the 8lb rise but now has to continue his good work on a very different track, and he was a lot lower in the weights when second to Garde Des Champs in this 12 months ago.
runners.comment: Has been on fire at Hexham but now has to continue his good work on a very different track

runners.name: Garde Des Champs
runners.spotlight: Better at this trip than the 2m4f over which he was third here ten days ago, but even when on a good day he's become extremely hard to win with (1-24 as a chaser and 2-39 overall); the clear plus is that he won this last year off 5lb higher.
runners.comment: Even when on a good day he's become extremely hard to win with

runners.name: Hypotenus
runners.spotlight: Free-goer who often makes the running and ultimately paid for giving chase to an improving winner when behind Garde Des Champs here a month ago; ran better behind the same winner the time before when he finished ahead of the Russell/Scudamore runner; a soft lead would help matters.
runners.comment: Below par here last time but capable of going well, especially if getting a soft lead

runners.name: Ras Kassar
runners.spotlight: Won all sorts in France, following Flat wins on turf and AW with two wins over fences and four as a hurdler (the latest in May on good ground over 2m2f); might not be on too bad a mark for this British debut; has won from the front and when held up.
runners.comment: Prolific in France (won all sorts) and might not be on too bad a mark for British debut

runners.name: Kinbara Firstdraft
runners.spotlight: Won two handicap hurdles for Stuart Crawford but he's not looking as good over fences and was behind Garde Des Champs here last time.
runners.comment: He's not looking as good over fences and was behind Garde Des Champs here last time

runners.name: Tree Top Tyson
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in a three-runner maiden hurdle; this mark should be manageable on the balance of his hurdle form but a forgettable chase debut in January needs forgiving; absent since.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler but a forgettable chase debut in January needs forgiving; absent since

races.race_name: Saints In The Community Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Summergrounds
runners.spotlight: Hasn't had that much racing for a 10yo; enjoys this ground and has a solid record over C&D, so one to consider as he ran quite well last time at Bangor in a higher grade (finished last but weakened only late on).
runners.comment: Enjoys this ground and has a solid record over C&D, so one to consider

runners.name: Lets Mingle
runners.spotlight: Won her maiden over C&D on good ground last May (four ran); hasn't looked on that good a mark since sent into handicaps and has been ridden by Jack Power in all bar one of those; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner who hasn't looked on that good a mark since sent into handicaps

runners.name: Atlantic City
runners.spotlight: All good in three runs for Olly Murphy, and after winning over C&D (good), she wasn't far from defying a 5lb rise at Aintree; just 2lb higher this time and looks sure to put up another bold show.
runners.comment: Three good runs for Olly Murphy include a C&D success; just as good in defeat since

runners.name: Bold Light
runners.spotlight: Should be well handicapped but has been below par for a good while now and more new headgear is tried after flirting with a tongue-tie last time; capable but risky.
runners.comment: Should be well handicapped but has been below par for a good while now

runners.name: Pure Gold
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who hasn't found her form in three starts following a break and there are stamina concerns to overcome at this trip.
runners.comment: C&D winner who hasn't found her form in three starts following a break; stamina queries
runners.owner: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing

runners.name: Struth
runners.spotlight: Former smart Flat horse who is 0-6 over hurdles and was beaten a little under 10l on handicap debut here a month ago; he was boxing on over 2m and this longer trip could bring him on (stayed well on the Flat).
runners.comment: Boxing on over 2m here on handicap debut so this longer trip is worth exploring

runners.name: Parikarma
runners.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner who is finding her feet after a long absence and she's an assured stayer over this far; looks handicapped about right but has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Handicapped about right but has each-way claims on the back of two solid efforts

runners.name: Noble Birth
runners.spotlight: Struggled with consistency towards the end of his time in Ireland, and failed to stay 3m6f on April's stable debut; more in his favour here, but others more persuasive.
runners.comment: More in his favour here than on stable debut, but others more persuasive

runners.name: Ceol Draiochta
runners.spotlight: Regressed in Ireland, including in two handicaps, after finishing runner-up in a maiden hurdle; could have needed the run when beaten 9l in a 2m novice at Kelso (good) in May but it's hard to make a compelling case.
runners.comment: Not solid on his Irish form and was beaten 9l in a Kelso novice on his yard debut

races.race_name: Sport, Education & Wellbeing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Inis Oirr
runners.spotlight: Exploited much-reduced mark over C&D (good) in April and finished second over C&D on both subsequent appearances (good to soft/good) but is no longer the force of old and others in this field have more appealing profiles.
runners.comment: Second twice since C&D win off reduced mark in April but others appeal more all the same

runners.name: Wasdell Dundalk
runners.spotlight: Four-time C&D winner; returned from break with two low-key runs this spring (hurdle/chase) but may have been aided by refitted cheekpieces when running big race in defeat here (2m4f, good) ten days ago; up in grade today but still on a good mark and this return to 3m is sure to suit.
runners.comment: Ran big race in defeat over 2m4f here recently and this return to 3m is sure to suit
runners.owner: Abbadis Racing & D A Harrison Racing

runners.name: Grand Clermont
runners.spotlight: Had long career in France before four British runs this season; won by 17l at Uttoxeter in May and has posted another two good efforts since, more recently when battling on for fourth in valuable contest back at Uttoxeter (also 3m, good) a fortnight ago; respected.
runners.comment: Won by wide-margin in May and also ran well on both outings last month; respected

runners.name: Statuario
runners.spotlight: Gained all seven chase wins at the track, the latest a dead-heat over this trip in April (good ground); on fairly tough mark now but last month's Perth Gold Cup fourth was respectable and he probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Seven-time course winner; on fairly tough mark now but probably won't be far away

runners.name: Bleu d'Enfer
runners.spotlight: Has modest 2-30 strike-rate under rules but kept on well for second at Aintree (2m4f, good) in May and has now filled that position twice since his wind operation in March; could plausibly still have untapped potential over 3m; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Has modest strike-rate but runner-up twice since wind op in March, and unexposed over 3m

runners.name: Parisencore
runners.spotlight: Gained both chase wins over 2m4f (one here); no match for progressive rival when second at Hexham (1m7f, good; first run after wind surgery) last month but that was still a good effort; a possible if suited by this new trip.
runners.comment: Dual 2m4f winner; ran well over 1m7f last month; a possible if this new trip suits
runners.owner: Miss D Sellars & Exors Of Mrs Ic Sellars

runners.name: Walk On Quest
runners.spotlight: Won three-runner contest at Kelso (2m7f, good) in May and is still on a workable mark but never really got competitive in last month's Perth Gold Cup and needs to put that run behind him.
runners.comment: Won three-runner race in May but well held over C&D in last month's Perth Gold Cup

races.race_name: Saints Kidz Community Football Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Ballintubber Boy
runners.spotlight: Disappointed at Huntingdon (a course he likes) in May, after a break, and didn't find much at business end when last of four finishers at Worcester (2m7f, good) last month; on a good mark but arrives here with questions to answer.
runners.comment: On good mark but below form on both outings since returning from break in May

runners.name: Secret Trix
runners.spotlight: Six-time hurdle winner who was placed off today's mark on his last four appearances, most recently when second at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) last month; seems very likely to be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Placed off today's mark on last four appearances; very likely to be on the mix again

runners.name: Lowlands
runners.spotlight: Made all in 2m4f maiden here (good) in May, after a break, and also ran well when second on handicap return at Cartmel (2m6f, good) a fortnight later; upped further in trip today and remains lightly raced for her age; could still have more to offer; highly respected.
runners.comment: Won 2m4f maiden in May and ran well in 2m6f handicap later that month; still low mileage

runners.name: Ebselysees
runners.spotlight: 2-4 for new stable this year, with both wins gained from the front here (3m/3m2f); below form at Hexham last month but sure to be suited by the return to this track and could take some catching; cheekpieces refitted.
runners.comment: Below form at Hexham last time but a dual course winner this spring; respected back here

runners.name: Speed Davis
runners.spotlight: Two hurdles wins last season, the latter when upped to 2m7f at Bangor (good) in April; still unexposed over this sort of trip but was tailed off when dropped back to 2m4f last month; hard to predict.
runners.comment: Won when upped to 2m7f in April but tailed off over 2m4f since; hard to predict

runners.name: Spit Spot
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner last autumn (good/soft); ended last season with some disappointing efforts, though, and looked badly out of sorts on both Flat appearances this spring; leap of faith required to support her today.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner in the autumn but looked out of sorts on both Flat outings this spring

runners.name: Dalileo
runners.spotlight: Course regular who looked as good as ever when keeping on strongly from off the pace for clearcut C&D (good) win ten days ago; 6lb higher in a stronger race today but can make his presence felt again.
runners.comment: Clearcut C&D winner ten days ago; 6lb higher in stronger race today; still respected
runners.owner: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing

races.race_name: Scone Palace International Horse Trials Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Centurion's Sister
runners.spotlight: In the frame all six hurdling starts, most recently when clear second of four on last month's handicap debut at Bangor (2m, good); competes off unchanged mark here and features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Clear second of four on handicap debut and has now made the frame on all six hurdle starts

runners.name: Scots Poet
runners.spotlight: Resurgent 10yo who led close home over C&D (good) last month and has now won three of his last four; probably doesn't have much margin for error after latest 5lb rise but must be considered in current mood.
runners.comment: Resurgent 10yo; led close home over C&D last month and has now won three of his last four

runners.name: Malangen
runners.spotlight: Veteran who has gained four of his ten hurdle wins at this track and often builds up a big lead; needs to rebound from a disappointing effort here (2m4f) ten days ago but was in a consistent vein of form beforehand and is still on a workable mark.
runners.comment: Didn't fire here recently but was in good form beforehand; often builds up a big lead
runners.owner: T Hunter & D A Harrison Racing

runners.name: Follow Charlie
runners.spotlight: Has slipped to a tempting mark but needs to up his game after some below-par recent efforts; gained all four wins at about 2m4f and is probably better suited by ground slower than good; others preferred.
runners.comment: On good mark but not at best lately; seems best over 2m4f on ground slower than good

runners.name: Storm The Dug
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who kept on from the rear for second of 14 over C&D (good) on handicap debut in April; didn't really build on that run when fifth of 12 here last month but still considered; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Fair Flat racer; second over C&D on handicap hurdle debut in April; considered

runners.name: Jolyjump
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two chases for Gary and Josh Moore towards end of 2024-25 season but absent since heavy defeat on stable debut just over a year ago; reverts to hurdling with quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Absent since heavy defeat over fences on stable debut just over a year ago

runners.name: Tigress Lilly
runners.spotlight: Safely held when sixth over C&D (good) on both recent outings and has now been unplaced all six hurdling starts; not written off just yet but clearly needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: Safely held when sixth over C&D on both recent outings and now 0-6 over hurdles

runners.name: Lucky In Taipan
runners.spotlight: Placed on bumper debut in 2024 for Fergal O'Brien; struggled in four novice/maiden hurdles for Max Young last year but makes stable/handicap debut off a lowly mark and it will be very interesting to see what Ben Pauling can do with him.
runners.comment: Struggled in novice/hurdles last year but makes stable/handicap debut from basement mark

races.race_name: Welcome To Family Day Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Tiny Riot
runners.spotlight: Put in place by main market rival when second of four at Market Rasen (2m, good; raced too freely) last month but beat a next-time-out winner when scoring on hurdle debut at Hexham (2m, good) a few days earlier and has obvious claims here.
runners.comment: Well held when second last time but won on hurdle debut at Hexham a few days earlier

runners.name: Lucky Sevens
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner (albeit at a lowly level) in cheekpieces this spring (1m/1m2f) and made pretty good start to hurdling career when clear second of five over C&D (good to firm; no headgear) a fortnight ago; now has cheekpieces refitted; good chance.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner who was clear second of five over C&D on recent hurdle debut

runners.name: Hello Garda
runners.spotlight: Irish raider; 0-5 on the Flat but kept on for second in low-grade Chepstow handicap (1m2f, good to firm) in first-time cheekpieces a fortnight ago; can feature if he takes well to hurdling.
runners.comment: Second in low-grade Flat handicap last month (1m2f); can feature if he takes to hurdling

runners.name: Just Call Me Mo
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all six Flat runs for Joseph Parr, showing no significant promise (including off lowly marks); changed hands for 1,000gns in May; cheekpieces removed after one use; best watched on stable/hurdle debut.
runners.comment: Showed no significant promise on the Flat; makes stable/hurdle debut after 1,000gns sale

races.race_name: Next Sunday Is Ladies Day Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Brionywells
runners.spotlight: Has improved this term since stepping up in trip, getting off the mark at Worcester (2m7f, good) in May and followed up at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) last month; didn't fare too badly off 7lb higher when fourth of seven finishers at Market Rasen (2m7f, good) last time and she may warrant another chance.
runners.comment: Scored at Worcester and Uttoxeter this summer; fourth last time.

runners.name: Son Of Tyran
