runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when stepping up in trip at Ludlow (3m, good) in May; not in the same form when seventh of ten at Worcester (2m7f, good) in race won by Brionywells last time; first-time blinkers need to have an impact following a short break.
runners.comment: Won at Ludlow in May; behind Brionywells last time.

runners.name: Bits Ballou
runners.spotlight: Showed improvement up in distance when runner-up at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) on her handicap debut last month; on a workable mark and should run well.
runners.comment: Showed improvement when runner-up at Newton Abbot on her handicap debut last month.

runners.name: Babychino
runners.spotlight: Third over hurdles for the second time at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) last month; this step up in trip needs to eke out more improvement.
runners.comment: Third over hurdles for the second time at Uttoxeter last month.

runners.name: French Diablo
runners.spotlight: Showed best form when third of seven over C&D (good to firm) 13 days ago on handicap debut; needs to improve again but that is not out of the question.
runners.comment: Showed best form when third over C&D 13 days ago on handicap debut.

runners.name: Pink Walls
runners.spotlight: Struggled to get competitive off basement Flat marks in 2023 and, following a long absence, has made an inauspicious start to her hurdling career for new stable this year; 8lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Has made an inauspicious start to her hurdling career for new stable this year.

runners.name: League Clash
runners.spotlight: Hasn't stood much racing and returns from a 671-day break following wind surgery with a new trainer; lacks the scope of his rivals and best watched unless the market speaks in his favour.
runners.comment: Hasn't stood much racing and returns from a 671-day break following wind surgery.

races.race_name: Gary Hubball's 60th Celebration Year Novices' Handicap Chase

runners.name: Laffer Curve
runners.spotlight: Made a pleasing start over fences when runner-up at Worcester (2m4f, good) last month; her performance when pulled up at Hexham subsequently was too bad to be true; first-time cheekpieces are now applied and she still has time on her side.
runners.comment: Runner-up on her chase debut at Worcester last month but pulled up at Hexham last time.

runners.name: Frankie Faulkner
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner; 0-12 over fences but placed a good few times but took a backward step last time when beaten 45l at Fontwell (3m2f, good); first-time visor replaces cheekpieces with tongue-tie retained; has a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Placed a good few times but took a backward step last time when beaten 45l at Fontwell.

runners.name: Rockvale
runners.spotlight: Made the frame for the second time over fences when fourth of eight finishers at Bangor (3m, good) last month in first-time tongue-tie (retained); holds place claims.
runners.comment: Made the frame for the second time over fences when fourth at Bangor last month.

runners.name: Miss Pearl
runners.spotlight: 0-17 under rules and plodded on to grab third at Worcester (2m4f, good) last month; sports first-time tongue-tie but lacks the scope of her younger rivals.
runners.comment: 0-17 under rules and plodded on to grab third at Worcester last month.

runners.name: Royal Time
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler in Ireland; no great shakes over fences so far; sold for 11,000euros to join this yard in May; runs without usual headgear on British/stable debut and best watched unless the market speaks in his favour.
runners.comment: No great shakes over fences so far; sold for 11,000euros to join this yard in May.

runners.name: Artiste d'Ainay
runners.spotlight: Won the second of two points in April before being sold for £10,000; got off the mark over hurdles at Southwell (3m, good) last month when making all; well held at Worcester subsequently but must be of interest on chasing debut.
runners.comment: Made all over hurdles at Southwell last month; well held subsequently; chase debut.

runners.name: Citizen Jane
runners.spotlight: Landed her third point in May; finished a modest second on her chase/stable debut here (2m3f, good to firm) 13 days ago; runs without hood worn on last four starts; has more on her plate here.
runners.comment: Finished a modest second on her chase/stable debut here 13 days ago.

runners.name: My Lovely Horse
runners.spotlight: Has shown little under rules so far; best watched on chase debut.
runners.comment: Has shown little under rules so far; best watched on chase debut.

runners.name: Shuile Warrior
runners.spotlight: Won a point last year and is still unexposed under rules but was pulled up at Bangor (3m, good) on handicap/chase debut in April; difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: Pulled up at Bangor on handicap/chase debut in April.

races.race_name: University Hospitals Birmingham Charity Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Genealogy
runners.spotlight: Had wind surgery since failing to land the odds at Worcester (2m; bled from nose) last time on debut for Faye Bramley; form for Irish yards featured a success on the Flat and good second over hurdles; major contender provided he's back on song.
runners.comment: Major player on the pick of his form for Irish yards; second start for Faye Bramley

runners.name: Gambino
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo whose Flat form features a win in Ireland and sound third to Constitution Hill on debut for Dan Skelton; had wind surgery since underpeforming last time; promising third at Newbury (2m) in sole hurdles attempt and looks open to progress in this sphere; respected.
runners.comment: Has fairly useful Flat form; promising third at Newbury in sole hurdles attempt; respected

runners.name: Penzance
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old (one-time useful Flat handicapper) but has made the frame in two Stratford events since rejoining Shark Hanlon, albeit proved no match for a Skelton-trained 11-10 favourite last time; likely to be a similar story today.
runners.comment: Has made the frame in two Stratford events since rejoining Shark Hanlon

runners.name: Angel Of My Dreams
runners.spotlight: Point bumper whose rules form, which includes a thoroughly remote second at Stratford, is far from convincing; had wind surgery since last run, which was her hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Point bumper winner whose rules form is far from convincing

runners.name: Delgany Second Now
runners.spotlight: Stablemate of Gambino; has cut little ice in three races and looks one who'll be more interesting when qualified for handicaps.
runners.comment: Likely to be more interesting when qualified for handicaps

runners.name: Usyk
runners.spotlight: Has failed to transfer the pick of his bumper form to hurdles and ran out, possibly not entirely due to a slipped saddle, at Stratford most recently.
runners.comment: Has failed to transfer the pick of his bumper form to hurdles

runners.name: Haderach
runners.spotlight: Brings the worst form having achieved virtually nothing (Flat/hurdles); moreover, has failed to complete in three attempts under this code.
runners.comment: Brings the worst form having achieved virtually nothing

races.race_name: Visit Zoolab In The Centre Course Handicap Chase

runners.name: Thickthorn Tom
runners.spotlight: Is better over fences and got off the mark at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good) in May; produced another solid effort when second at Market Rasen (2m3f, good) last month; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces and looks sure to be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Is better over fences and got off the mark at Newton Abbot in May; second since.

runners.name: Bahtiyar
runners.spotlight: Longstanding maiden who has been making the frame on a regular basis until finishing last of five at Warwick (2m4f, good) last month; hard to fancy for win purposes.
runners.comment: Longstanding maiden who finished last of five at Warwick last month.

runners.name: Definite Dream

runners.name: Lovero
runners.spotlight: Largely in good form over 1m for new stable this season and coped well with drop back in trip when fourth (just behind Super Express) from wide stall over C&D last month; not ideally drawn today either but still considered.
runners.comment: Better known as a miler but ran well from wide stall when dropped back to 7f last month

runners.name: Titan Pegasus
runners.spotlight: 2-3 as a 2yo in Australia, the latter win gained in 5.5f Group 3; denied clear run on both Hong Kong starts but made headway into midfield once in the clear here (6f) last time and looks worth a crack at 7f.
runners.comment: Denied clear run on both HK starts but made headway once in the clear last time (6f)

runners.name: Voyage Horizon
runners.spotlight: Made winning debut over an extended 7f in Australia in December; remains an unknown quantity but makes Hong Kong debut after seven-month break and in a competitive race.
runners.comment: Won on debut in Australia; makes HK debut after seven-month break and isn a good race
runners.owner: Ching Chi Fai, Tommy Ching Tsun Wah & Mandy Ching Tsin Wai

races.race_name: Haras de Fresnay-Le-Buffard Prix Jean Prat (Group 1) (No Geldings) (Turf)

runners.name: True Love
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of racing, pairing seven top-class sprinting performances as a 2yo, with mostly better ones this year over 7f and a mile; followed 1,000 Guineas win with two more solid ones and the drop to 7f looks something she could well enjoy; receives the sex allowance and a leading chance.
runners.comment: Ran respectably since winning the 1,000 Guineas; drop in trip looks a plus
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Time To Turn
runners.spotlight: Only once out of the first two in a busy juvenile campaign, latterly over 7f, which saw him behind the second-placed Nighttime in the Group 1 Prix Jean-Luc Lagardere before winning the Group 3 Horris Hill Stakes (7f, soft) in October; made a good return to action when runner-up to highly regarded stablemate Talk Of New York in late May at a mile, and should have more to come as a 3yo.
runners.comment: Only made his reappearance recently and can improve; more needed, though

runners.name: Thesecretadversary
runners.spotlight: Most progressive keen-going colt, who followed a reappearance Group 3 win in April over 7f with comfortably held efforts in the English and Irish Guineas; improved on those with a drop in class and trip, landing the Jersey Stakes on good to firm; shapes as a solid sort who should give his running back up to Group 1 company and Christophe Soumillon on for first time.
runners.comment: Won the 7f Jersey Stakes at Royal Ascot; Christophe Soumillon on for first  time
runners.owner: Cayton Park Stud & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Rayif
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner here as a 2yo and Group 1 placed (albeit behind Nighttime), both times at 7f, and won the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains on his first try over a mile when making his seasonal return in May, Nighttime back in sixth; that form hasn't been hugely advertised since and a bit surprising he's not been kept to a mile, but drop in trip holds few concerns and big player considering he's lightly raced.
runners.comment: Won Poule d'Essai Des Poulains on his seasonal return in May; drop in trip should be okay

runners.name: Nighttime
runners.spotlight: Top-level performer; second in last year's Group 1 Prix Jean-Luc Lagardere, finishing ahead of Rayif, but 3l behind that rival from a wide draw in the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains during May; confirmed his potential for better when beating a couple of these in the 7f Prix Paul de Moussac on good to soft last month, and should be fighting for a place at least.
runners.comment: Likeable type who belongs at this level; should be fighting for a place at least

runners.name: Samangan
runners.spotlight: Stable/ownermate of Rayif; had plenty of decent form last year, but hasn't progressed as of yet as a 3yo, although wasn't far short of his best in the Group 1 Commonwealth Cup (6f, good to firm) 23 days ago; cheekpieces go on but Mickael Barzalona unsurprisingly prefers Rayif.
runners.comment: Stable/ownermate of Rayif; capable of good form but needs to step up to play a part

runners.name: Go Man
runners.spotlight: Consistent French performer, who finished less than a length behind Nighttime 35 days ago in the 7f Group 2 Prix Paul de Moussac on good to soft; may still do better but this looks a tough task to add another win to his tally.
runners.comment: May still do better but this looks a tough task to add another win
runners.owner: Christian Faure, J-M Lefebvre et al

runners.name: Imperior
runners.spotlight: Finished well behind Rayif in the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains and then had Nighttime and Go Man in front of him in the Prix Paul de Moussac when last seen; would need a big career best to land this.
runners.comment: Has lots to find on the figures and other much easier to make cases for
